mechanism_narrative: Rising quarterly GDP (GDPC1) above 2% growth signals robust demand, boosting corporate earnings and equity valuations, leading to positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive in >60% of instances when GDPC1 exceeds 2% growth, or returns are negative despite sustained GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6.5% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 returns as it signals labor market tightening and improved employment prospects.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when UNRATE crosses below 6.5%, or returns are negative despite sustained rate decline.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in FEDFUNDS above 0.15% and quarterly GDP (GDPC1) growth above 2% amplify equity valuation growth through dual easing signals, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both proxies exceed thresholds, or returns are negative despite high FEDFUNDS and GDP growth.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained rise in FEDFUNDS above 2% signals potential over-tightening, prompting market anticipation of future rate cuts that boost equity valuations, leading to positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when FEDFUNDS exceed 2% in late-cycle regime, or returns are negative despite sustained FEDFUNDS rise in that regime.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained monthly industrial production (INDPRO) growth above 3% signals robust supply-side momentum, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, driving positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not positive when INDPRO exceeds 3% growth, or returns are negative despite sustained production growth.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 6% coupled with rising FEDFUNDS above 0.1% creates a dual signal of labor market improvement and monetary easing, amplifying equity returns over 20 days.
regime_hint: improving labor market and easing cycle
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both conditions are met, or returns are negative despite the dual signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1 >5%) and industrial production expansion (INDPRO >5%) create a virtuous cycle of corporate earnings growth and valuation expansion, driving positive 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not positive when both proxies exceed 5% growth, or returns are negative despite high growth in both.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPIAUCSL exceeding 2.0% signals inflationary pressures, prompting market anticipation of Fed rate hikes that compress equity valuations, resulting in negative 20-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 20-day returns not negative when CPIAUCSL crosses above 2.0%, or returns are positive despite elevated inflation.
